description: The Contractor shall provide all personnel, supervision, equipment, tools, test instruments OEM replacement parts, materials, and non-personal services necessary to perform semi-annual inspections, operational testing, preventative maintenance, winterization/de-winterization, and repairs on the Fire Department (FD) Helicopter Trainer (O-100), Structural Trainer (T-500), and Aircraft/Hose Line Trainer (O-100) (collectively referred to as the Automated Fire Training Facility (AFTF) or "Live-Fire Trainers"). The goal is to ensure the facilities remain fully operational and serviceable. The Contractor must perform all work according to the manufacturer’s recommendations, relevant technical orders (TOs), all applicable local, state, and federal guidelines, and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) standards.
